subject: Re: InfiniteNature-Zero kickoff — perpetual view generation
body: Status through June 9. Repro: done — the pretrained LHQ checkpoint runs end-to-end and our flythroughs match the project-page examples qualitatively; FID on our held-out LHQ split is 14.6 vs 14.2 reported. The pain point is the environment: the codebase pins Python 3.8 / CUDA 11.3, and the StyleGAN2 upgrade patch (stylegan2_upgrade.patch) doesn't apply cleanly against the newer rosinality revision, so Saoirse froze a known-good commit in our image. Softmax splatting also needed a rebuild for our driver stack. Risk for the retrain: our licensed corpus skews coastal; early finetunes drift toward water textures after ~200 steps of autoregressive generation. Csilla is testing a resampled mix. Nothing blocking the July plan yet. — Gustavo
